question:
Fill in the blank with an appropriate option.

The social ______ is going to meet with all of us tomorrow with the plans so we can make a decision.
solution:
The correct answer is: **worker**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The appropriate word to fill in the blank is "worker."
 
• The word "worker" fits the blank because it refers to a person who is involved in labor or employment.
 
• In the context of the sentence, it indicates that the social "worker" is going to meet with all of us tomorrow.
 
• This suggests that the social worker is a person engaged in social welfare activities or community work, likely involved in making plans and decisions related to social issues or projects.

Therefore, the correct answer is: The social ***worker__*** is going to meet with all of us tomorrow with the plans so we can make a decision.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Now, let's provide the meanings of all the options along with their Hindi meanings:

 
• **Army:** A well-organized military force equipped for warfare. (सेना)
 
• **Worker: **A person engaged in work, especially in manual labor or as part of a particular occupation or industry. (कार्यकर्ता)
 
• **Toddler:** A young child who is just beginning to walk. (छोटा बच्चा)
 
• **Labour:** Work, especially physical work. It can also refer to the organized body of workers who are employed in industries or a particular type of work. (मजदूर, श्रमिक)
